skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 3-hit combo to all enemies, each hit dealing 7000% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] (only affected by advanced DMG modifiers). Ignores 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. The 1st hit has a 150% chance to inflict [Disorder] on targets hit for 3 turns. [Disorder]: Before any character takes action, if the target is not under [Specialized Unyielding] or [Extreme Tenacity], deals 4000% ATK [Disorder DMG] based on Overgrown Rover’s ATK. The effect disappears after triggering and can stack. Ignores 100% [DoT DMG Reduction], and pierces [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 3-hit combo to all enemies, each hit dealing 9000% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] (only affected by advanced DMG modifiers). Ignores 60% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. The 1st hit has a 150% chance to inflict [Disorder] on targets hit for 3 turns. [Disorder]: Before any character takes action, if the target is not under [Specialized Unyielding] or [Extreme Tenacity], deals 5500% ATK [Disorder DMG] based on Overgrown Rover’s ATK. The effect disappears after triggering and can stack. Ignores 100% [DoT DMG Reduction], and pierces [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction].

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. All allies also gain 70% [True DMG Reduction]. Dispels [DoT DMG Bonus Reduction] effects from all allies for the entire battle. When [Rebattle] is triggered, the power of this unit’s [Charge Follow-Up] Ultimate is increased to 1.1 times.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. All allies also gain 75% [True DMG Reduction]. Dispels [DoT DMG Bonus Reduction] effects from all allies for the entire battle. When [Rebattle] is triggered, the power of this unit’s [Charge Follow-Up] Ultimate is increased to 1.2 times.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. All allies also gain 80% [True DMG Reduction]. Dispels [DoT DMG Bonus Reduction] effects from all allies for the entire battle. When [Rebattle] is triggered, the power of this unit’s [Charge Follow-Up] Ultimate is increased to 1.25 times.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: On entry, permanently reduces the action count of all enemies’ [Extreme Tenacity] ignore-DMG effect by 1. Gains 4 stacks of [Rebattle]. [Rebattle]: Permanently reduces DMG taken by 75% (each return to battle increases this effect by an additional 2.5%). When an ally in the same row, or all allies, are defeated, if this unit is already defeated, consumes 1 stack of [Rebattle] to immediately return to battle, restores 100% HP, and performs a [Charge Follow-Up] on a random target at 120% Ultimate power. If there are other defeated allies in the same row, there is a 70% chance to trigger this effect for them as well.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: On entry, permanently reduces the action count of all enemies’ [Extreme Tenacity] ignore-DMG effect by 2. Gains 5 stacks of [Rebattle]. [Rebattle]: Permanently reduces DMG taken by 78% (each return to battle increases this effect by an additional 2.8%). When an ally in the same row, or all allies, are defeated, if this unit is already defeated, consumes 1 stack of [Rebattle] to immediately return to battle, restores 100% HP, and performs a [Charge Follow-Up] on a random target at 135% Ultimate power. If there are other defeated allies in the same row, there is a 100% chance to trigger this effect for them as well.

effects.desc: PvP (advanced) tier of Resilience — shield ignores stronger damage, only penetrated by advanced breakers.
The shield ignores top tier damage, blocks certain incoming attacks, and when activated can deal massive Chaos damage, bypassing normal dodge/reduction effects.
Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
Reduces incoming true damage by a large percentage (e.g. 70%), a rare shield against normally unblockable damage.
Reduced damage taken from non-critical attacks.
Before a character acts, if without a shield, suffer heavy ST-based Disorder DMG. Cumulative; disappears after activation.
Evasion PvP tier — reduces specialized attacks to 1 damage; pierced by the ignore dodge effect.
Advanced tier of direct damage, only affected by advanced damage increase/decrease and passes through normal defenses.
Massive ST damage type associated with the Disorder debuff, ignores ST Reduction over time and penetrates Specialized Evasion, disappears after activation.
Permanently reduces damage taken; When defeated, spend a layer to return to 100% Health and pursue.
